verdict.rationale: Docs claim Claude Code can debug live apps, plan fixes, and 'verifies it works' across multi-file changes (claude-code-docs-2/17/28/51), supporting reproduce/root-cause/verify workflows, but hands-on community reports give a concrete counter-example where self-verification failed (a replace_all bug silently corrupted a constant, 'You absolutely can't trust it to self-verify') and describe recurring low-quality 'simplest fix' patches that break things (claude-code-comm-16, claude-code-comm-17). missing for 10: independent benchmark/case study specifically on bug reproduction and root-cause isolation, and resolution of the self-verification reliability concerns raised by users.
